lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: You'd think after making it this far, they'd stop underestimating the foreigner.
lines.moment: The waiting room. Bai and Zei are watching the board.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: It wouldn't be so annoying if he wasn't so damn pretty.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: Nah, way too fake for me.
lines.moment: Zei gives her a look, eyebrow raised.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Such patience...
lines.moment: Bai spits something into the nearby trash can.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: Total wimp, just like you. But it gets you guys the W.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: That other loser's toast. He should have already thrown in the towel, but doesn't even know it yet.
lines.moment: Bai finally gives the board a serious look. Studying it

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Good job out there.
lines.moment: Deluin comes out. Zei and Bai are there.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Thanks. Yeah, the walls held out. Haven't yet watched your replay, but will be sure to tonight.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Yeah, please ignore the ugly style. I also won by defense though, but for most of the game it just looks like I'm running scared.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Patience often does, until you win. Hey, do you want to get tea later? I'll be at the courtyard in about a longhour.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Sure, yeah, that works well for me!

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Great, I'll see you then. Bai, you're welcome to come too. Hope to see you there! Bai.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: See you. So are you gonna come? Should be fun!
lines.note: "See you." to Deluin as he goes; the rest to Bai
lines.moment: She shrugs, with a disgruntled look on her face. Deluin goes. Bai gives Zei…

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: He's your competition, remember?

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Take it easy, you're my competition too.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: 'Was.' And you know I hate you. And I know all your tricks already anyway.
lines.note: re-recorded 2026-10-16; the script follows the performance

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: Deluin? We don't know anything about this guy.
lines.moment: She says it with a smile, and continues.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: So let's get to know him, it'll be fun! Maybe he won't be so fake after all.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Hey, over here! We were just talking about you!

lines.speaker: Robot
lines.text: jie mo kai tu jie hei ja ma?
lines.moment: A robot slides up to the table.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Whoa
lines.note: the book's line restored, owner 2026-10-15; the "Whoa" take
lines.moment: A menu appears: the book's own glyph picture.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: I think these are some of the new symbols that they're A/B testing for the Dzegoban version nine.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Have you heard about version nine?
lines.moment: He realises he's talking to a foreigner.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: I had a couple people mention it to me. Making the language visual.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Hmmm. More straight horizontal lines than usual, and the three diagonal lines on the right. probably pronunciation markers?
lines.note: after c14-b115; looking over the menu after "Hmmm"

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Top right is 'kai', right? The extra vertical vein on the left is unusual, although I'm not sure I would make the images so detailed when they have such different meanings, depending on the context.

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Wait, you know Dzegoban?

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: The whole point of Dzegoban is that you can learn it in less than a month.
lines.note: after c14-b118; in a lecturing tone

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: I'm impressed, you're almost a local already.

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: Actually, I don't think I want anything. Plus, I've got a lot to catch up on. Zei, when you're done, come get me. I want to go over some things with you.
lines.moment: Bai whips round with a half-baked excuse.

lines.beat_title: The question and the sugar wall
lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: So while visiting, I've been wondering about the differences between home and here. And I've been wondering, why does Dzego like Minpentai so much?
lines.moment: Tea poured. Deluin starts stacking sugar cubes.

lines.beat_title: The question and the sugar wall
lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Kids get into it pretty young here, I guess. Whole family involved, it's a big thing. One of our quirks, just like the language. Does Redshire have any quirks?

lines.beat_title: The question and the sugar wall
lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Sure. Yeah, we have our fair share. We care a lot about natural beauty, and maybe have an unnatural obsession with old styles. Less cameras, more castles, that kind of thing.

lines.beat_title: The question and the sugar wall
lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: I see where you get your love of walls then.
lines.moment: Deluin's stack has turned into a little wall of sugar cubes.

lines.beat_title: The question and the sugar wall
lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Yes. Simple, straightforward, useful.
lines.moment: Deluin looks down at the sugar cubes, and smiles.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Why don't you come visit? My parents just told me I need to come back for an early birthday celebration for them, so you can come with me!

lines.speaker: Zei
lines.text: Well, budget will be pretty tight for... about fifteen days.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Oh yeah, then I can use some of my winnings to pay for your trip, right?
lines.moment: He says it with a smile.

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: You're welcome to come too, Bai!

lines.speaker: Bai
lines.text: What?!! Dreadnaught!! It's good! You should check it out.
lines.note: points at the headphones before "It's good!"
lines.moment: Bai makes a big show of pulling off one side of her headphones. The…

lines.speaker: Deluin
lines.text: Dze go ba fau gie
lines.moment: Dusk at the courtyard gate, with the lamps coming on.
